plugins.name: mangrove-agent
plugins.description: Mangrove gives trading agents guardrails. Built-in risk management on every order: circuit breakers, drawdown limits, automatic risk-based position sizing and automatically generated stop-loss and take-profit orders. Local MCP server and plugin with 100+ tools for strategy R&D, backtesting and live execution across 12+ venues (Kraken, Robinhood, TradeStation, DEX on 10 EVM chains). Keys and wallets stay on the user's machine. Free Mangrove API key or x402 pay per call.
